description: Purpose-bound minimal audit receipt grammar (PST-X01, ReceiptMin RQ1). A receipt is a signature-bound commitment to one governed audit event: it proves the event occurred under a declared purpose and policy epoch and lets a forensic reconstructor verify any omitted field by digest recomputation, while the receipt itself stores no clinical payload, no free text and no raw identifiers. additionalProperties false plus a closed token/pattern vocabulary means every raw-PHI or hidden-ID smuggling attempt is rejected fail-closed (ADDITIONAL_PROPERTY / PATTERN_MISMATCH). Digest and signature verification semantics live in the receipt.v1 disclosure protocol; cross-epoch admissibility is adjudicated by the independent forensic oracle, not by this grammar.

issued_at.description: Receipt issuance timestamp, RFC 3339 UTC with 'Z' suffix only. Local-time offsets are rejected so receipt ordering is deterministic across tenants.

omitted_field_digest.description: SHA-256 (lowercase 64-hex) of the canonical JSON serialization (UTF-8, sorted keys, separators ',' and ':') of the complete omitted-fields object declared for this operation's audit query class. Forensic reconstruction verifies an omitted field by recomputing this digest over the candidate value and comparing equality; the receipt never stores the omitted value itself.

operation.description: Audit query class performed. Closed enum; free-form operation names are rejected.

policy_epoch.description: Monotonically increasing combined consent/policy/retention epoch under which the event was authorized, bound at issuance. Consumers must refuse receipts whose epoch is not registry-live for (tenant, purpose); cross-epoch replay is rejected at the disclosure-protocol layer on top of this token grammar.

principal.description: Pseudonymous principal token of the acting account. Raw user names, emails or medical-record numbers are not representable.

purpose.description: Declared processing purpose. Closed enum; a purpose value that encodes a patient attribute is rejected as unknown.

receipt_id.description: Globally unique, tenant-scoped receipt identifier; also the stable logical operation id that makes persisted receipt effects idempotent under retry.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 (lowercase 64-hex) over the canonical JSON of the receipt body (every field except signature), keyed by the verification key bound to (tenant, policy_epoch) in the external key registry. Key material and key ids are externalized; tampering with any body field invalidates the receipt (fail closed, DETECT_TAMPER).

tenant.description: Pseudonymous tenant token scoping the receipt. Free-text tenant names are rejected.

version.description: Receipt grammar version. Only '1' (additive-only evolution within receipt.v1); consumers must refuse unknown versions instead of best-effort parsing.

title: CLARA-Care 2027 pst purpose-bound minimal audit receipt (receipt.v1)
